decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the firm's established data integration offer, has its own web page and so visible commitment, and costs little to maintain, so it likely meets aspirations and calls for no search.
The building digital twin service is more exploratory and its results are uncertain, but the firm's slack as a 190-person firm with its own R&D lets it carry the service while market demand develops.
Authentication and delegation is close to the core and complements the identity offering, so problemistic search is unlikely, though it may later be merged with product E.
The open GIS application framework is central to the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and supports its project business, so it stays.
The identity service was actively promoted at launch and fits the integration of GIS into enterprise systems, so it likely meets aspirations.
